# 15 AI Tools That Actually Work in India 2026 (Tested)
- February 17, 2026
- Blog

I spent ₹50,000 and 3 months testing 67 AI tools to find which ones actually work in India.

Most AI tools have three problems for Indians:

1. **Payment issues** (cards declined, no UPI)
2. **Slow speeds** (servers in US/Europe)
3. **No Hindi support** (English-only interfaces)

# AI Could Soon Make UPI Payments for You: India Plans Registry for AI Agents — How It May Work
## Will UPI Users Have to Pay Extra?
The development of AI-driven payments does not mean ordinary UPI users will automatically face transaction charges.

The Government of India has separately stated that consumers making UPI payments will not face transaction charges and that person-to-person transactions will remain free
